stories.title: Police target anti-social behaviour with new Connah’s Quay operation
stories.summary: North Wales Police has launched Operation Lens in Connah’s Quay. It follows an increase in reports of anti-social behaviour involving groups of young people in the area, particularly during the early hours of the morning. stories.title: Education minister vows to tackle ‘root causes’ of school antisocial behaviour
stories.summary: Wales’ education minister has vowed to tackle the “root causes” of antisocial behaviour in schools. stories.title: Welsh Water to spend £7m upgrading Pantymwyn wastewater works
stories.summary: Welsh Water is investing £7 million to upgrade wastewater infrastructure serving Pantymwyn and Cilcain, after regulators tightened the standards the current treatment works must meet. stories.title: Loggerheads Country Park reopens refurbished visitor centre and café
stories.summary: Improvement works at Loggerheads Country Park have been completed, with a launch event held earlier this month to mark the finish of a project including new flood defences and a refurbished visitor centre. stories.title: RSPCA needs north Wales volunteers as gull rescues pile up this summer
stories.summary: Five orphaned herring gull chicks found near Prestatyn have been taken in by an RSPCA wildlife centre, as the charity appeals for more volunteer drivers across north Wales.
